    5   def pbReduceHP(amt, anim = true, registerDamage = true, anyAnim = true)
    6     amt = amt.round
    7     amt = @hp if amt > @hp
    8     amt = 1 if amt < 1 && !fainted?
    9     oldHP = @hp
   10     self.hp -= amt
   11     PBDebug.log("[HP change] #{pbThis} lost #{amt} HP (#{oldHP} -> #{@hp})") if amt > 0
   12     raise _INTL("HP less than 0") if @hp < 0
   13     raise _INTL("HP greater than total HP") if @hp > @totalhp
   14     @battle.scene.pbHPChanged(self, oldHP, anim) if anyAnim && amt > 0
   15     if amt > 0 && registerDamage
   16       @droppedBelowHalfHP = true if @hp < @totalhp / 2 && @hp + amt >= @totalhp / 2
   17       @tookDamageThisRound = true
   18       @tookMoveDamageThisRound = true
   19     end
   20     return amt
   21   end

   23   def pbRecoverHP(amt, anim = true, anyAnim = true)
   24     amt = amt.round
   25     amt = @totalhp - @hp if amt > @totalhp - @hp
   26     amt = 1 if amt < 1 && @hp < @totalhp
   27     oldHP = @hp
   28     self.hp += amt
   29     PBDebug.log("[HP change] #{pbThis} gained #{amt} HP (#{oldHP} -> #{@hp})") if amt > 0
   30     raise _INTL("HP less than 0") if @hp < 0
   31     raise _INTL("HP greater than total HP") if @hp > @totalhp
   32     @battle.scene.pbHPChanged(self, oldHP, anim) if anyAnim && amt > 0
   33     @droppedBelowHalfHP = false if @hp >= @totalhp / 2
   34     return amt
   35   end

   54   def pbTakeEffectDamage(amt, show_anim = true)

   57     yield hp_lost if block_given?   # Show message

   64   def pbFaint(showMessage = true)
   65     if !fainted?
   66       PBDebug.log("!!!***Can't faint with HP greater than 0")
   67       return
   68     end
   69     return if @fainted   # Has already fainted properly
   70     @battle.pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("{1} fainted!", pbThis)) if showMessage
   71     PBDebug.log("[Pokémon fainted] #{pbThis} (#{@index})") if !showMessage
   72     @battle.scene.pbFaintBattler(self)
   73     @battle.pbSetDefeated(self) if opposes?
   74     pbInitEffects(false)
   75     # Reset status
   76     self.status      = :NONE
   77     self.statusCount = 0
   78     # Lose happiness
   79     if @pokemon && @battle.internalBattle
   80       badLoss = @battle.allOtherSideBattlers(@index).any? { |b| b.level >= self.level + 30 }
   81       @pokemon.changeHappiness((badLoss) ? "faintbad" : "faint")
   82     end
   83     # Reset form
   84     @battle.peer.pbOnLeavingBattle(@battle, @pokemon, @battle.usedInBattle[idxOwnSide][@index / 2])
   85     @pokemon.makeUnmega if mega?
   86     @pokemon.makeUnprimal if primal?
   87     # Do other things
   88     @battle.pbClearChoice(@index)   # Reset choice
   89     pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::LastRoundFainted] = @battle.turnCount
   90     if $game_temp.party_direct_damage_taken &&
   91        $game_temp.party_direct_damage_taken[@pokemonIndex] &&
   92        pbOwnedByPlayer?
   93       $game_temp.party_direct_damage_taken[@pokemonIndex] = 0
   94     end
   95     # Check other battlers' abilities that trigger upon a battler fainting
   96     pbAbilitiesOnFainting
   97     # Check for end of primordial weather
   98     @battle.pbEndPrimordialWeather
   99   end

  104   def pbSetPP(move, pp)
  105     move.pp = pp
  106     # No need to care about @effects[PBEffects::Mimic], since Mimic can't copy
  107     # Mimic
  108     if move.realMove && move.id == move.realMove.id && !@effects[PBEffects::Transform]
  109       move.realMove.pp = pp
  110     end
  111   end

  113   def pbReducePP(move)
  114     return true if usingMultiTurnAttack?
  115     return true if move.pp < 0          # Don't reduce PP for special calls of moves
  116     return true if move.total_pp <= 0   # Infinite PP, can always be used
  117     return false if move.pp == 0        # Ran out of PP, couldn't reduce
  118     pbSetPP(move, move.pp - 1) if move.pp > 0
  119     return true
  120   end

  122   def pbReducePPOther(move)
  123     pbSetPP(move, move.pp - 1) if move.pp > 0

  129   def pbChangeTypes(newType)
  130     if newType.is_a?(Battle::Battler)
  131       newTypes = newType.pbTypes
  132       newTypes.push(:NORMAL) if newTypes.length == 0
  133       newExtraType = newType.effects[PBEffects::ExtraType]
  134       newExtraType = nil if newTypes.include?(newExtraType)
  135       @types = newTypes.clone
  136       @effects[PBEffects::ExtraType] = newExtraType
  137     else
  138       newType = GameData::Type.get(newType).id
  139       @types = [newType]
  140       @effects[PBEffects::ExtraType] = nil
  141     end
  142     @effects[PBEffects::BurnUp] = false
  143     @effects[PBEffects::Roost]  = false
  144   end

  156   def pbChangeForm(newForm, msg)
  157     return if fainted? || @effects[PBEffects::Transform] || @form == newForm
  158     oldForm = @form
  159     oldDmg = @totalhp - @hp
  160     self.form = newForm
  161     pbUpdate(true)
  162     @hp = @totalhp - oldDmg
  163     @effects[PBEffects::WeightChange] = 0 if Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6
  164     @battle.scene.pbChangePokemon(self, @pokemon)
  165     @battle.scene.pbRefreshOne(@index)
  166     @battle.pbDisplay(msg) if msg && msg != ""
  167     PBDebug.log("[Form changed] #{pbThis} changed from form #{oldForm} to form #{newForm}")
  168     @battle.pbSetSeen(self)
  169   end

  230   # Checks the Pokémon's form and updates it if necessary. Used for when a
  231   # Pokémon enters battle (endOfRound=false) and at the end of each round
  232   # (endOfRound=true).
  233   def pbCheckForm(endOfRound = false)
  234     return if fainted? || @effects[PBEffects::Transform]
  235     # Form changes upon entering battle and when the weather changes
  236     pbCheckFormOnWeatherChange if !endOfRound
  237     # Darmanitan - Zen Mode
  238     if isSpecies?(:DARMANITAN) && self.ability == :ZENMODE
  239       if @hp <= @totalhp / 2
  240         if @form.even?
  241           @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(self, true)
  242           @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(self)
  243           pbChangeForm(@form + 1, _INTL("{1} triggered!", abilityName))
  244         end
  245       elsif @form.odd?
  246         @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(self, true)
  247         @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(self)
  248         pbChangeForm(@form - 1, _INTL("{1} triggered!", abilityName))
  249       end
  250     end
  251     # Minior - Shields Down
  252     if isSpecies?(:MINIOR) && self.ability == :SHIELDSDOWN
  253       if @hp > @totalhp / 2   # Turn into Meteor form
  254         newForm = (@form >= 7) ? @form - 7 : @form
  255         if @form != newForm
  256           @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(self, true)
  257           @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(self)
  258           pbChangeForm(newForm, _INTL("{1} deactivated!", abilityName))
  259         end
  260       elsif @form < 7   # Turn into Core form
  261         @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(self, true)
  262         @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(self)
  263         pbChangeForm(@form + 7, _INTL("{1} activated!", abilityName))
  264       end
  265     end
  266     # Wishiwashi - Schooling
  267     if isSpecies?(:WISHIWASHI) && self.ability == :SCHOOLING
  268       if @level >= 20 && @hp > @totalhp / 4
  269         if @form != 1
  270           @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(self, true)
  271           @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(self)
  272           pbChangeForm(1, _INTL("{1} formed a school!", pbThis))
  273         end
  274       elsif @form != 0
  275         @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(self, true)
  276         @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(self)
  277         pbChangeForm(0, _INTL("{1} stopped schooling!", pbThis))
  278       end
  279     end
  280     # Zygarde - Power Construct
  281     if isSpecies?(:ZYGARDE) && self.ability == :POWERCONSTRUCT && endOfRound &&
  282        @hp <= @totalhp / 2 && @form < 2   # Turn into Complete Forme
  283       newForm = @form + 2
  284       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("You sense the presence of many!"))
  285       @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(self, true)
  286       @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(self)
  287       pbChangeForm(newForm, _INTL("{1} transformed into its Complete Forme!", pbThis))
  288     end
  289     # Morpeko - Hunger Switch
  290     if isSpecies?(:MORPEKO) && hasActiveAbility?(:HUNGERSWITCH) && endOfRound
  291       # Intentionally doesn't show the ability splash or a message
  292       newForm = (@form + 1) % 2
  293       pbChangeForm(newForm, nil)
  294     end
  295   end

  297   def pbTransform(target)
  298     oldAbil = @ability_id
  299     @effects[PBEffects::Transform]        = true
  300     @effects[PBEffects::TransformSpecies] = target.species
  301     pbChangeTypes(target)
  302     self.ability = target.ability
  303     @attack  = target.attack
  304     @defense = target.defense
  305     @spatk   = target.spatk
  306     @spdef   = target.spdef
  307     @speed   = target.speed
  308     GameData::Stat.each_battle { |s| @stages[s.id] = target.stages[s.id] }
  309     if Settings::NEW_CRITICAL_HIT_RATE_MECHANICS
  310       @effects[PBEffects::FocusEnergy] = target.effects[PBEffects::FocusEnergy]
  311       @effects[PBEffects::LaserFocus]  = target.effects[PBEffects::LaserFocus]
  312     end
  313     @moves.clear
  314     target.moves.each_with_index do |m, i|
  315       @moves[i] = Battle::Move.from_pokemon_move(@battle, Pokemon::Move.new(m.id))
  316       @moves[i].pp       = 5
  317       @moves[i].total_pp = 5
  318     end
  319     @effects[PBEffects::Disable]      = 0
  320     @effects[PBEffects::DisableMove]  = nil
  321     @effects[PBEffects::WeightChange] = target.effects[PBEffects::WeightChange]
  322     @battle.scene.pbRefreshOne(@index)
  323     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} transformed into {2}!", pbThis, target.pbThis(true)))
  324     pbOnLosingAbility(oldAbil)
  325   end
